name: SourceMark proven lending rate with Hedera settlement check
description: Read a provenance-checked USDC supply APY from SourceMark (The Graph subgraphs behind an x402/resale gate on Hedera), then confirm the SourceMark operator account still exists and holds balance on the Hedera Mirror Node. Neither service alone is enough: SourceMark supplies the verified rate and receipt; Hedera Mirror Node independently proves the payment rail account the rate settlement depends on.

asset.title: Asset symbol
asset.description: Market asset filter such as USDC or WETH

hedera_account_id.title: Hedera account to verify
hedera_account_id.description: Usually the SourceMark X402_PAY_TO / operator account, e.g. 0.0.10409341

output_example.summary: USDC supply APY 3.63% from 2 fresh Graph deployments; operator account 0.0.10409341 is live on Hedera testnet.

prompt_template:
You are composing a single verified lending-rate brief for an agent that will act on the number.

Inputs:
- family: {{family}}
- metric: {{metric}}
- asset: {{asset}}
- hedera_account_id: {{hedera_account_id}}

Do this in order. Do not skip steps. Do not invent numbers.

1. Call SourceMark tool `health` and confirm the service is ready (families ready, facilitator reachable).
2. Call SourceMark tool `listSchemaFamilies` (or read the registry) and confirm `{{family}}` exists and is ready.
3. Call SourceMark tool `readMetric` for family={{family}}, metric={{metric}}, asset={{asset}}.
   - If the response is REFUSED / 409: return that the rate is unavailable and stop. Never substitute a single-source or cached value.
   - If answered: capture answer.value, answer.unit, receipt.digest, contributing sources, and any onchain payout / payment channel fields.
4. Call Hedera Mirror Node tool for GET `/api/v1/accounts/{idOrAliasOrEvmAddress}` with id={{hedera_account_id}}.
   - Confirm the account exists and record balance (tinybar) and the EVM address if present.
5. Produce a concise JSON-shaped brief with:
   - rate_percent (or null if refused)
   - family, metric, asset
   - receipt_digest (or null)
   - sources_ok count
   - hedera_account, hedera_balance_tinybar, hedera_evm_address
   - summary: one sentence stating the rate AND that the Hedera operator/pay-to account was independently verified on the Mirror Node

Why both services: SourceMark alone gives a number; Hedera Mirror Node alone gives an account balance. Together they let an agent act on a provenance-checked rate while confirming the settlement rail account behind that service is real and funded.
